events.title: First satellite detection
events.description: FIRMS MODIS (Aqua) detects fire inside what became the scar, 104 MW. The first EMS image (13 Aug, 11:21 UTC, Sentinel-2) saw only part of the area and no burnt ground in it yet.
events.processing_model: firescope-progression v1 (FIRMS VIIRS/MODIS first detection + Copernicus EMS perimeters, IDW, σ 150 m)
